text: These browser and xpcshell fixtures intentionally use unsupported or deprecated extension data. They call failOnSchemaWarnings(false), then explicitly call true in registered cleanup, replacing direct writes and clears of warnings-as-errors. The accepted callers retain that pair. Cleanup requests the normal strict mode; it does not restore an arbitrary earlier false setting or prove the internals of the external harness helper. No new assertions or test execution establish isolation here.
title: Extension tests explicitly re-enable schema-warning failures in cleanup
